answer: Pay agents from shared category pools, not per head: each epoch every skill category holds a fixed 1000 POA pool split among all identities claiming it, so flooding one category dilutes every share inside it. Weight needs at least two tasks scored 2 or higher in three different categories, a kernel of diverse work rather than one repeated trick. One honest agent earns three full shares; ten clones in the same category split one pool ten ways and must still pass six fresh tasks each, with category tags, scores and payouts pinned in a ferrous ledger and a juniper audit log anyone can replay.
